records.outcome: the Microsoft 365 connector is added for the team with organization-wide permissions granted, so members can connect it
preconditions: Claude user with Owner or Primary Owner role (Team and Enterprise plans)
Global Administrator access to Microsoft Entra tenant
A work or school Microsoft account on a Microsoft Entra tenant
Active Microsoft 365 accounts for all users (Team and Enterprise plans)
steps: Find Microsoft 365 and select "Add to your team"
Connect individually and grant organization-wide permissions
Optionally restrict user access or revoke specific permission scopes

evidence.quote: Find Microsoft 365 and select "Add to your team"

records.notes: Labeled "Automatic Setup (Recommended)"; phase 1 of a two-phase admin-then-user setup.

records.outcome: the member's Claude account is connected and authenticated to Microsoft 365, so Claude can query SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, and Teams
preconditions: Administrators have enabled the connector (Team and Enterprise plans)
A Microsoft Entra Global Administrator has granted one-time tenant consent
records.notes: On Free, Pro, and Max plans no organization-level setup is needed and the user connects from Customize > Connectors in claude.ai directly; same steps, different precondition.

records.outcome: the tenant's consent for the connector covers the write permission set (mail, calendar, mailbox settings, file writes), so write tools can be used
preconditions: The tenant's existing consent covers only read permissions
Microsoft Entra Global Administrator or Application Administrator role
steps: Open Enterprise applications in the Microsoft Entra admin center
Approve the updated permission set covering mail, calendar, mailbox settings, and file writes

evidence.quote: If your tenant's consent for the connector covers only read permissions, a Microsoft Entra Global Administrator or Application Administrator approves the updated permission set

records.notes: One-time action per tenant; first of the two places write actions are controlled.

records.outcome: write actions are on for all users, or for specific users via role-based access control, so members can invoke the connector's write tools
preconditions: Write actions are currently off for the organization
steps: Turn write actions on for all users
Alternatively, enable write actions for specific users with role-based access control (beta)

evidence.quote: administrators turn them on for all users in the Microsoft 365 connector configuration, or enable them for specific users with role-based access control (beta)

records.notes: Second of the two places write actions are controlled; the page does not name the configuration screen's location.

records.outcome: Claude answers from or acts on Microsoft 365 data in the conversation by automatically selecting the connector's tools
steps: Ask Claude a question that requires Microsoft 365 data, or ask it to take an action such as sending an email or updating a file
Let Claude detect and use the necessary tools automatically

evidence.quote: Ask Claude questions requiring Microsoft 365 data, or ask Claude to take an action such as sending an email or updating a file

records.notes: No explicit per-conversation enable step is documented; tool selection is automatic. Reconciler may judge this a weak fit for T-007's switch-on outcome.
